tasks.spec: ROLE: fix worker for the Mott goal-loop Bland pathway, round 20 - named times keep the established date and go straight to one confirmation. Work entirely inside your CWD; never modify anything outside it; no network, no git, no MCP/Apps/skills; do not mint, attach, deploy, or call any API. CONTEXT - measured live on v115 this morning, two defects in one transcript: (A) WRONG WEEK: the patient asked 'How about next Thursday?' and correctly got 08/13 offers; they then typed '1045' and the system offered, confirmed and booked 08/06 - a week earlier. The named-time route uses the UNPINNED anchor search, which re-resolves the date from a bare weekday instead of holding the already-offered date. (B) DOUBLE CONFIRMATION: after '1045' the flow said 'I have ... 10:45 am. Reply 1 to take it' and only then 'To confirm ... Reply YES to book it'. Ankit's ruling: when the patient names a time that exists on the established date, go STRAIGHT to the single booking confirmation. THE GATEWAY IS BEING EXTENDED IN PARALLEL (lane 49): an anchor search now returns 'anchor_exact' (true only when the first returned slot equals the requested clock exactly) plus 'anchor_requested'. Build against that contract. SOURCES (copy into CWD, then edit): /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD26/gl-round19-fix/ (round-19 draft = v115), validator (assertions 1-19), build scripts, frozen-extractors.json. THE FIX: (1) ADD availability webhook n_goal_search_offered_anchor, cloned from n_goal_search_anchor with exactly two deltas: body 'from' and 'to' both exactly '{{slot_1_start}}' (pinning the search to the date already offered) and body time_pref stays 'anchor={{goal_anchor}}'. Body stays inside the ten-field gateway contract (store, from, to, after, before, time_pref, slot_minutes, callID, user_text, user_verbatim) - no extra keys. Its responseData copies the anchor search's mappings and ADDS anchor_exact from $.result.anchor_exact and anchor_requested from $.result.anchor_requested. (2) ROUTE: the n_goal_response named-time edge (round 18's label about naming a specific clock time including bare digit forms) now targets n_goal_search_offered_anchor instead of n_goal_search_anchor. The n_goal_ask pre-offer named-time/around-a-time edge keeps targeting the unpinned n_goal_search_anchor (no offer exists yet to pin to). (3) PATHWAYS out of n_goal_search_offered_anchor, using executable conditions: anchor_exact == true AND slot_count >= 1 -> n_gate_1 (straight to the single booking confirmation, no intermediate offer); anchor_exact != true AND slot_count >= 1 -> n_time_pick_offer (which already says the exact time is unavailable and offers the closest single opening); slot_count == 0 or ok != true -> the same miss target the other searches use (n_goal_ask). (4) n_gate_1's copy and BOOKING-INTEGRITY rule are unchanged - it still restates {{slot_1_day_name}} {{slot_1_start}} verbatim and refuses to confirm a mismatch, which is the safety net if anchor_exact were ever wrong. (5) Everything else from rounds 6-19 unchanged. (6) VALIDATOR: add ASSERTION 20 keeping 1-19 intact: n_goal_search_offered_anchor exists with from/to pinned to {{slot_1_start}}, time_pref anchor={{goal_anchor}}, a contract-clean body, and an anchor_exact mapping; the n_goal_response named-time edge targets it; its exact path reaches n_gate_1 and its non-exact path reaches n_time_pick_offer; the pre-offer named-time edge still targets the unpinned anchor search. Structured FAIL citing 'assertion 20'; must PASS your draft and FAIL the untouched round-19 draft at /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD26/gl-round19-fix/pathway-goalloop-draft.json citing assertion 20. (7) build_goalloop.py regenerates deterministically; fixture-conformant.json updated. (8) DEBUG.md: the transcript evidence for both defects, the changes, regeneration command; mention extract/prompt/compress context as before.
tasks.verified: A named clock time after an offer searches the ALREADY OFFERED date (no more week jumps) and, when that exact time exists, goes straight to a single booking confirmation - with the gate's mismatch refusal still standing as the safety net and every guard from rounds 8-19 asserted.
